sources.safe_use: Omega_B0 and Omega_P0 are algebraic a^-4 terms in the canonical background equation.
sources.forbidden_inference: Their sign, perturbation physics, physical identity and validated priors are not established by algebraic presence alone.

sources.safe_use: RLL_2_transition_plus_radiative_terms explicitly exposes Omega_B0 and Omega_P0 as free parameters.
sources.forbidden_inference: Free parameter listing is not a posterior constraint.

sources.safe_use: Audit the historical illustrative ranges Omega_B0, Omega_P0 in [1e-6,1e-5].
sources.forbidden_inference: Do not treat blueprint ranges as current priors, measurements or fitted posteriors.

sources.citation: A. Bazavov et al. (HotQCD), Phys. Rev. D 90, 094503 (2014)
sources.safe_use: 2+1-flavor continuum QCD EoS, analytic pressure fit and thermodynamics for 130-400 MeV.
sources.forbidden_inference: QCD-sector g_rho/g_s are not the total Standard-Model cosmic degrees of freedom.

sources.citation: Bazavov et al. 2014 accepted manuscript footnote 1
sources.safe_use: Record that preliminary pre-2014 HISQ/tree EoS conference results had an incorrect fermion normalization and were superseded.
sources.forbidden_inference: This is documented scientific correction, not evidence of censorship.

sources.citation: S. Borsanyi et al., Nature 539, 69-71 (2016), arXiv:1606.07494
sources.safe_use: Full-SM thermal EoS/effective degree-of-freedom framework across cosmological temperatures; includes charm and higher-temperature completion.
sources.forbidden_inference: Numeric full-SM g_rho/g_s must be ingested from its supplementary data before precision H(T) claims.

sources.citation: HotQCD chiral crossover temperature, Phys. Lett. B 795 (2019)
sources.safe_use: Use Tc(0) about 156.5 +/- 1.5 MeV as a modern chiral-crossover reference.
sources.forbidden_inference: Crossover temperature alone does not specify a first-order transition.

sources.citation: Particle Data Group 2024, Big-Bang Nucleosynthesis review
sources.safe_use: BBN tests radiation-era expansion near T~1 MeV; Nnu=2.898+/-0.141 (68% CL) and effective SM Nnu=3.044 are reference inputs.
sources.forbidden_inference: BBN does not directly reconstruct the QCD transition; extra magnetic/plasma physics may affect nuclei beyond background H.

sources.citation: Planck Collaboration VI, Astron. Astrophys. 641, A6 (2020), arXiv:1807.06209
sources.safe_use: N_eff=2.99+/-0.17 with BAO as a CMB radiation compatibility reference.
sources.forbidden_inference: N_eff is not an exact surrogate for arbitrary magnetic/plasma perturbations.

sources.citation: E. Calabrese et al., ACT DR6 Constraints on Extended Cosmological Models, JCAP 2025
sources.safe_use: N_eff=2.86+/-0.13; with external BBN 2.89+/-0.11; no evidence for self-interacting dark radiation, primordial magnetic fields, early dark energy or modified recombination.
sources.forbidden_inference: These summaries are not a dedicated RLL likelihood or a model-independent Omega_B0/Omega_P0 bound.

sources.citation: Planck 2015 XIX, Constraints on primordial magnetic fields, arXiv:1502.01594
sources.safe_use: PMFs require perturbation, Faraday, ionization, non-Gaussianity and anisotropy treatment; background energy density alone is incomplete.
sources.forbidden_inference: Do not identify canonical Omega_B0 with a specific B_1Mpc limit without a spectrum/helicity/coherence mapping.

sources.citation: J. Shao, H. Mao, M. Huang, Phys. Rev. D 111, 023052 (2025)
sources.safe_use: First-order QCD scenarios can source stochastic gravitational waves.
sources.forbidden_inference: Physical-mass standard cosmic QCD at small chemical potential is a crossover; bubble-GW templates are conditional on nonstandard/BSM first-order physics.

sources.citation: I. Musco, K. Jedamzik, S. Young, Phys. Rev. D 109, 083506 (2024)
sources.safe_use: QCD-era softening changes PBH collapse thresholds and mass functions.
sources.forbidden_inference: PBH phenomenology is not evidence for RLL without a primordial power-spectrum and formation model.

sources.safe_use: Track current BSM-QCD/PBH model space as a future falsifier/sensitivity branch.
sources.forbidden_inference: Preprint model exploration is not an observation or confirmation.

sources.citation: M. Giordano, T. G. Kovacs, F. Pittler, arXiv:2602.10921 (2026)
sources.safe_use: Dirac-mode localization onset is reported in the 150-160 MeV crossover region.
sources.forbidden_inference: Localization is not a cosmological RLL observable.

sources.safe_use: O-O and Ne-Ne flow constrains nuclear geometry/QGP hydrodynamics.
sources.forbidden_inference: v2/v3 are not a cosmological RLL likelihood.
